text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 897 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. Beginning with the tobacco trading year 1976, no person, corporation, partnership or association shall
buy locally grown Virginia leaf tobacco at prices lower than the following:
GRADE AP8.00 per kilogram
GRADE B7.50 per kilogram
GRADE C7.00 per kilogram
GRADE D6.50 per kilogram
GRADE E6.00 per kilogram
The description of each grade shall be determined by the Philippine Virginia Tobacco Administration.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
